mobile.title: Golden dunes stretch across the Dunas de Maspalomas in Gran Canaria, their surfaces revealing an intricate tapestry of wind-shaped textures. In the foreground, deep, oval footprints interrupt the fine, densely packed sand, their compressed edges forming raised rims and small, sharply defined shadows. Delicate wind ripples run in closely spaced, parallel ridges across the gently sloping surface, creating alternating bands of illuminated crests and narrow, shaded troughs.
